name: Celebrate
overview: Scripture calls believers to celebrate with joy and praise because of God's enduring mercy, sovereign creation, and the gift of eternal life through Christ. The psalmist declares that in God's presence there is fullness of joy and everlasting pleasures, urging us to rejoice in the day the Lord has made. Praise is commanded as a response to God's power and faithfulness, while Lamentations reminds us that His mercies never fail. Ultimately, the greatest cause for celebration is God's love demonstrated by giving His only begotten Son so that believers may have everlasting life.
